ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white/light-grey) central region occupying approximately 65% of the surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) peripheral margins and internal linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity (black) band along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; high-intensity (white) central mass bifurcated by a vertical low-intensity (black) column extending from the peduncle to the median notch; numerous low-intensity linear streaks distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a vertical depth reaching 1/6th of the fluke's total height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the outer 1/3 of both lobes; smoother, lower-amplitude topography near the median notch; distinct jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating at the notch transitioning into a convex curve towards the mid-lobe, terminating in a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white and dark pixel groups (barnacle scars) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated circular high-contrast pixel clusters on the mid-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing horizontally and diagonally across the upper surfaces of both lobes, particularly dense on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense scarring consistent with predatory rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive, isolated low-intensity circular ring-shaped scar (approximately 15 pixels in diameter) located in the upper-mid quadrant of the right lobe.
